recommendations.name: Risk-based auto-approval with deterministic gates (PostHog StampHog pattern)
recommendations.description: Let an agent approve only PRs that pass deterministic gates (no conflicts, small diff, none of the high-risk areas like auth, secrets or billing), and escalate everything else to the owning human, failing closed.

recommendations.name: Separate reviewer agents that triage findings, so humans only see the ambiguous ones
recommendations.description: Have different agents or models, not the one that wrote the code, review each PR and sort findings into fix, nit or escalate, so people only look at what the agents cannot settle.

recommendations.name: Intent-based review summaries that surface high-risk changes first (Salesforce approach)
